# JSON for Modern C++

Vendored upstream single header: nlohmann/json **v3.12.0**.

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE.nlohmann-json` and the upstream header.

Used to parse/serialize JSON messages and UTF-8 text records. Catalogue, review, scoring, ranking, validation and transaction logic are implemented in the project's own C++ files.
